context: a letter from Williams & Norgate, which you are answering
exchanges:
The translation of origin of species from Stuttgart have not yet arrived.— The Academy has not published a new edition of their dictionary, we believe Poitevin’s new french dictionary 2 vols 4o. (60/ ½ morocco) is superior to the Academy’s    English french    the best dict. is Flemmings (2 vols 4o. 50/)    we shall take care to address your parcels and letters according to directions receivd.

Yours very oblig | fpa Williams & Norgate | Ernest Greenoak

Charles Darwin Esquire

I am much obliged for information about French Dicy. , when next in London, I will call & speak on subject.—

Please send me by Post the number of Westminster Review which will be published tomorrow or immediately afterwards

Yours faithfully | C. Darwin
